response.sql: WITH award_winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS batting_hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS manager_count FROM award_winners GROUP BY batting_hand) SELECT batting_hand, manager_count, 1.0 * manager_count / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM award_winners) AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY batting_hand

assumptions.assumption: Whitespace-only batting-hand values count as blank; each player_id has one batting hand in player.
